--- title: "Pipeline" vignette: > %\VignetteIndexEntry{Pipeline} %\VignetteEngine{quarto::html} %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8} --- ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Load cfb2nfl from the checkout when the package is not installed, so the # site build does not require a package install (decision 0030). if (requireNamespace("cfb2nfl", quietly = TRUE)) { # vignettes render in a fresh quarto R session: attach the installed package # (CI installs it via local::.) or source the checkout fallback below. library(cfb2nfl) } else { dir <- getwd() while (!file.exists(file.path(dir, "_targets")) && dirname(dir) != dir) { dir <- dirname(dir) } for (src in sort(list.files(file.path(dir, "R"), pattern = "[.]R$", full.names = TRUE))) { source(src, local = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8") } } library(targets) library(dplyr) # Under altdoc, docs render in a temp dir; point the knit working directory at # the project root so tar_read()/tar_mermaid() find the store, _targets.R, and R/. root <- cfb2nfl_root() if (nzchar(root)) knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root) ``` ::: The processing pipeline is a [`targets`](https://books.ropensci.org/targets/) graph (decision 0004) — the single source of truth for how raw data becomes features, models, and results. The map below is **generated from the graph**, so it can't drift from what the code actually does. ## Stages ```{mermaid} flowchart LR ingest[ingest\nCFBD + nflverse] --> clean[clean\nstandardize + coerce keys] clean --> link[link\nplayer-season backbone + joins] link --> features[features\nlongitudinal change] features --> model[model\nexplain + predict] model --> report[report\nsite + viz] clean -.-> contracts[(data contracts)] clean -.-> audit[(audit log)] link -.-> audit features -.-> audit ``` ## Live dependency graph `tar_visnetwork()` renders the graph as an interactive `visNetwork` widget: nodes carry the target name and runtime, clicking a node shows its output, and the widget renders faster than a large static Mermaid diagram. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} tar_visnetwork(allow = NULL, label = "time") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` + raw_games_chunk declared [34 branches] + raw_game_team_stats_chunk declared [279 branches] + raw_game_player_stats_chunk declared [279 branches] ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}
``` ::: ::: ## What remains Targets that are outdated (need to run) — a live view of what's left to build or refresh. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} outdated <- tryCatch(tar_outdated(), error = function(e) character(0)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` + raw_games_chunk declared [34 branches] + raw_game_team_stats_chunk declared [279 branches] + raw_game_player_stats_chunk declared [279 branches] ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} if (length(outdated)) { tibble::tibble(target = outdated) } else { cat("All targets are up to date.") } ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` All targets are up to date. ``` ::: ::: ::: {.callout-important} ## Known gaps `/roster` is now ingested, keyed on an authoritative `season` (stamped from the queried year — the endpoint's own `year` is the eligibility class). But roster **weight is static per player**, so the decision-0003 between-season `weight_delta` is not derivable and was dropped; we keep the static roster `weight`. The `model` and `report` stages are wired placeholders. Post-draft **NFL outcomes** (nflverse) are now ingested and bridged to picks by draft slot, but as *labels* — they stay off the model input path to avoid leakage (decision 0014). :::
